description: This file exports a function that enables a Chromium feature flag in Electron to work around a bug involving file system access via the File System Access API. It does so by appending an experimental switch to Electron's command line arguments.

methods.name: enableExperimentalFeaturesForFileAccessFix
methods.description: A function that enables the 'enable-experimental-web-platform-features' switch in Electron's command line options to fix a bug related to the File System Access API.
